name: Lethal Ape : Revived
summary: Lethal Ape: Revived throws you and your fellow monkes into a high-stakes survival nightmare. Locked inside a mysterious research facility, you must navigate dark corridors, sealed chambers, and eerie laboratories while two relentless monsters hunt you down—Ashy, the burning shadow that strikes without warning, and Sand Man, the silent stalker who smothers all hope.
